shots.description: Mateo drives the orange Scarlet Arrow (plate SUN-8821) east down Ocean Drive toward the low sun over the sea, two Bay City PD patrol cars glued to his bumper, a roadblock ahead, the police helicopter low overhead with its searchlight on the road, traffic and pedestrians on both sidewalks, and a full HUD: three wanted stars, $15,300, mission panel M2 THREE GATES stage 1/3 with timer, dispatch board, minimap and health/armour/respect bars.
shots.title: Chase on Ocean Drive
shots.camera: low rear three-quarter chase, hero filling the lower third

shots.description: The chase turns north up a glass-tower avenue: police cars flank the Scarlet Arrow left and right, a roadblock waits ahead, colourful traffic fills both lanes, shop signs glow on both sides, the helicopter hangs over the street, and the HUD shows four wanted stars and M2 stage 2/3.
shots.title: Boxed in on the grid
shots.camera: low rear three-quarter chase, hero filling the lower third

shots.description: Night in the Little Havana market: Mateo aims his pistol between six striped stalls with lit signs and paper lanterns, three thick yellow tracers cut the dark, a muzzle flash lights his jacket, a downed enemy in red and a downed officer (1.35x scale) lie mid-frame, the crowd presses in, a roadblock and a patrol car hold the plaza edge, the yellow mission beacon burns at the far end, and the helicopter watches from above under a starry sky. Kira speaks from her portrait panel.
shots.title: Night market firefight
shots.camera: close over-the-shoulder, Mateo large in frame

shots.description: The PIER HEAT — Sunset Bay title screen over a living city: traffic and a patrol car on Ocean Drive, pedestrians on the sidewalks, pastel towers with big readable rooftop signs, and a beach foreground of palms, umbrellas and people. Start Engine button, controls list, and the real Slot 1 save: M2 PIER RUN, $15,300, Respect 140.
shots.title: Title screen over Sunset Bay
shots.camera: high wide view from the beach, palms and umbrellas in the foreground
